title: Project Closure
empty: The project has not been closed yet. Closure details will appear here once the Operations Officer records the signed and stamped inspection report.
form.title: Record Project Closure
form.signatureRequired: A signature or a photo of the signed report is required before closing the project.
form.mandatoryHint: Complete Ticket / Close Project stays disabled until a signature is captured or a photo of the signed and stamped inspection report is uploaded, and at least one installation photo has been added to the project.
form.irreversibleWarning: This action is final and irreversible. Once the project is closed, the closure record cannot be edited, deleted, or recorded again.
form.saveFailed: Failed to close the project. Please check your connection and try again — your captured signature has been kept.
